attributes.name: logo_placement_and_resolution
attributes.definition: How brand logos are supplied and where they are repeated on the page.

values.definition: Logos served at higher (2x) resolution and repeated in multiple places such as nav and hero.
Logo appears once at standard resolution.
No logo present.

attributes.name: author_photo_treatment
attributes.definition: How an author or person photo is shaped and captioned.

values.definition: Photo cropped to a circle with name and role text beneath.
Photo with a non-circular crop or different caption layout.
No author photo present.

attributes.name: illustration_presentation
attributes.definition: How illustrations are laid out on the page.

values.definition: Illustrations shown as individual rounded tiles or cards.
Illustrations used as large header or hero banners.
Illustrations embedded inline in other ways.
No illustrations.

attributes.name: footer_tone
attributes.definition: Overall brightness of the footer background.

values.definition: Light-coloured footer.
Dark-coloured footer.
Mid-tone, branded, or no footer.

attributes.name: missing_image_fallback
attributes.definition: What is displayed when an image is unavailable.

values.definition: A neutral gray placeholder box with explanatory text.
The browser's default broken image shown.
Image area removed or hidden.
No missing images in evidence.

attributes.name: alt_text_quality
attributes.definition: Quality and completeness of image alt text.

values.definition: All images have plain, human-readable alt text such as brand names.
Some images lack alt text.
Alt text is generic or filename-like.
Alt text intentionally empty on all images.
